en: Colorized panoramic view over a densely built Mediterranean city surrounded by hills. In the background stands a distinct conical hill (Lycabettus Hill) and, to the right, a large neoclassical palace-like building (the Old Royal Palace/Greek Parliament). The style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard. French and Greek captions appear at the top, and a website watermark is printed across the bottom.
